title: Transfer of additive Cech augmentations between resolutions
statement: Let X be any scheme, U any family of opens, I and J injective resolutions of its lifted additive structure sheaf, cI and cJ canonical resolution section comparisons [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison], and n a nonnegative degree. For the complexes and augmentations [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization], there exist cochain maps f:global(I)->global(J) and t:total(U,I)->total(U,J) such that alpha_I followed by t in degree n equals f in degree n followed by alpha_J. For every ordinary unit Cech cochain x, t sends beta_I(x) to beta_J(x). For every global homology class x, cJ(f_*(x))=cI(x). No covering, finiteness, affineness or separatedness assumption is needed.

source.place: Lemma 20.15.1, augmented double-complex diagram; Tag 03P2, Theorem 59.22.4, separated affine-cover argument.

proof.text: Lift the identity of the additive structure sheaf using InjectiveResolution.desc. Evaluate the lift for f. Apply the Cech functor termwise, flip the indices and totalize to define t. The total-map inclusion equation and presheaf naturality on each tuple prove the alpha square. Projection to every tuple and the equality I.augmentation followed by the lift = J.augmentation prove the beta square.

Represent a global homology class by a cycle using the epi homology quotient. The Hom-to-sections adjunction represents this cycle as a cocycle a. Naturality of that adjunction represents its image by a followed by the lift. Apply the defining canonical cocycle formulas for cI and cJ, and InjectiveResolution.extMk_comp_mk₀ for the identity lift. The identity Ext class acts identically, yielding the canonical equality. These arguments apply to empty covers and degree zero without modification.

proof_origin.place: Explicit cycle-level specialization of the augmentation diagram.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_additiveCech_resolution_transfer
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (I J : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (cI : Etale.ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison X.etaleAdditiveSheaf I)
    (cJ : Etale.ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison X.etaleAdditiveSheaf J)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : additiveCechGlobal I ⟶ additiveCechGlobal J,
    ∃ t : additiveCechTotal U I ⟶ additiveCechTotal U J,
      (additiveCechAlpha U I n ≫ t.f n = f.f n ≫ additiveCechAlpha U J n) ∧
      (∀ x, t.f n (additiveCechBeta U I n x) = additiveCechBeta U J n x) ∧
      (∀ x, cJ.globalEquiv n (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f n x) =
        cI.globalEquiv n x)
